details.description: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct is the mid-size, instruction-tuned model in Meta's Llama 3.1 family, a multilingual large language model Meta released July 23, 2024 alongside the 8B and 405B versions. It has a 131,072-token context window and a knowledge cutoff of December 2023, and Meta names English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish and Thai as its officially supported languages. It is built for assistant-style chat, reasoning, coding and agentic tool use, sitting between the 8B and 405B models in Meta's Llama 3.1 lineup on every benchmark Meta published.
advantages: Scores 83.6 on MMLU, 80.5% on HumanEval, 95.1% on GSM-8K (CoT) and 46.7% on GPQA, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Scores 90.0% on the API-Bank tool-use benchmark and 87.5 on IFEval, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
131,072-token context window, versus 8,192 tokens in the original Llama 3 70B model, per Fireworks' model page.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Scores lower than the 405B Instruct model on every benchmark Meta published, e.g. MMLU 83.6 versus 87.3, reflecting its smaller size.
use_cases: Coding assistance and agentic tool use via function calling
Complex reasoning and math problem solving
Synthetic data generation and model distillation

notes: Meta's model card and launch post round the context window to '128k' for all three Llama 3.1 sizes, but the catalog's facts give this target 131,072 tokens, matching the exact figure Fireworks' own model page states; used the catalog's/Fireworks' precise figure in the write-up instead of Meta's rounded one.
